audit.whatIsWrong: Chart disagreed with its own whys in five rows: whys[1] calls level 2 'your most abusable window' under a Skill row, whys[2] and whys[3] both say 'even' under Cho'Gath rows, whys[4] describes Feast deleting her under a Karma row, and whys[6] says teamfights stay 'even' under a Cho'Gath row. The full layer also read 7.5/10 difficulty on an EVEN tag with a 51.82% win rate over 795 games.
audit.why: Karma owns 1-2 on free Mantra-Q chip against a melee with only kill-sustain. 3 through 5 are even once Rupture-into-Feral Scream gives wave control. 6 and first item are Cho'Gath's on Feast. Two items is even again because her value is utility, not damage.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Karma / Karma / Skill / Skill / Cho'Gath / Cho'Gath / Skill; difficulty re-rated 6/10 to match the EVEN tag.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown appeared anywhere in the full layer despite the page telling the reader to 'engage on Focused Resolve's cooldown', and the level-6 line was the generic 'Karma's ultimate changes the math too'.
audit.why: Focused Resolve is a flat 12s, Inner Flame 9/8/7/6/5s, Inspire 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s, Mantra 40/38/36/34s and Feast 80/70/60s. Mantra is the important one and it is not a fixed clock: Gathering Fire reduces it every time one of her damaging abilities lands, so you cannot wait it out while she pokes you for free — you have to deny the hits.
audit.corrected: Focused Resolve's 12s, Mantra's 40s with the Gathering Fire refund, and Feast's 80s now appear in the phase, cooldown and interaction fields.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two problems. First, spikes[0], whys[0] and early all state that her Mantra-Q 'out-ranges your entire kit' — Riot's data gives Inner Flame 950 range, exactly the same as Rupture, and the Mantra bonus adds a delayed cataclysm, not extra range. Second, the interaction line described Focused Resolve as a root without saying how to beat it, and Gathering Fire was never mentioned at all.
audit.why: The real asymmetry is commitment, not range: she can throw a 950-range Q for free and walk away, while your 950-range Q is your engage. Focused Resolve (W, flat 12s, 675 range) is a tether — Riot's text says the root only lands if the tether is not broken, so leaving 675 range or breaking line of sight cancels it outright, and that is the counterplay a dashless champion actually has. Her Mantra-W also heals her, which is why anti-heal matters here.
audit.corrected: Focused Resolve is a tether — break line of sight or leave 675 range and it never roots. Gathering Fire refunds her Mantra as she pokes.

edits.before: Karma owns these levels — her mantra-empowered Q (RQ) out-ranges your entire kit and chips you while you last-hit. Your only sustain is Carnivore healing off minion kills, which can't keep pace with sustained poke, so don't try to out-trade her. Rupture is slow and telegraphed; she'll just walk out of it with her E speed boost, so don't waste it walking up — farm with Q at max range and the tip of your autos instead. Concede levels 2-3 like every lane bully concedes them to you, but stay above half so her RQ root into ult can't set up a clean gank.

notes: Corrected a range claim that appeared three times: the entry said Karma's Mantra-Q 'out-ranges your entire kit', but Riot's data gives Inner Flame 950 range, identical to Rupture, and the Mantra bonus adds a delayed cataclysm rather than extra range. The genuine asymmetry is that her Q is free and yours is your engage. Also added Gathering Fire, which was absent from the page entirely and is why Mantra cannot be waited out. Cho'Gath's kit flags Rupture as 'grounding'; Riot's description says it pops enemies into the air, so I wrote knockup.
